name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Gujarati
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-11): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Gujarati files have 'Dakshina Dataset' and 'Existing sources' rows, which the filter in training/mlkb/data/human.py drops (the project's licence audit keeps them out of a pack): 105,601 Dakshina and 3,094 Existing rows are dropped by the filter. What is used is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF: CC BY).
used_for: guj_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Samanantar, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/gu.neopack, and its 6,129 AK-Freq manual rows to fit and check the romanised Gujarati tables (data/langs/gu/romanisation.json): guj_valid.json has no manual rows, so a quarter of train's (by word; 1,607 pairs) calibrates. guj_test.json's manual rows (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, CC BY) are the held-out eval set: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-11. Extract with: unzip guj.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-guj/extracted (data/build-gu-text.sh does). guj_train.json has 1,143,212 rows: IndicCorp 1,013,574, Dakshina 86,832, Samanantar 31,343, AK-Freq 6,129, Existing 3,094, Wikidata 2,240. guj_valid.json 12,419: Dakshina 8,426, IndicCorp 3,398, Samanantar 499, Wikidata 96 (no manual rows). guj_test.json 18,077: Dakshina 10,343, AK-Freq 5,247, AK-NEI 1,481, AK-NEF 1,006. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/gu.neopack, a file handed out for a trial, not offered for download, not in the app
